title: Wheels Up
tagline: Three red lights — and the gravity extension jams too.
history: Inspired by airliners whose landing gear would not come down, normally or by the alternate system — among them a 2011 wide-body landed on its belly in Warsaw with no injuries after the crew circled to burn fuel.
situation: Inbound to Biggin Hill's runway 21 with 68 aboard. When you select the gear down, nothing happens. You'll try the alternate extension, but this one is going onto its belly.
failures: Landing gear will not extend (normal system)
tips: Try the alternate extension anyway (O → Systems: ALT GEAR)
Full flap, Vref, a normal stable approach to the centreline
Touch down gently with the wings level — props will strike

do.note: F/O: Gear down… three reds. No movement at all.
F/O: Alternate extension… nothing. It's jammed. We're landing on the belly.
